summary: This directory manages the translation logic for document processing, encompassing the identification of translatable content, the application of localized strings, and the overall execution of translation workflows.
responsibilities: Identify text elements within documents that require translation
Apply translated content to target document structures
relationships: Translation targets are identified before translation is applied to the document.
The translation process relies on defined targets to map original text to translated outputs.
designDecisions: Encapsulation of translation logic into specialized units
Test-driven development approach for translation workflows
